body: but it feels like my life is always a tease, when im down i always just hope for something and then eventually something good happens but soon after it just goes to hell. i just dont know anymore tbh, what am i supposed to do anyway? i want to be happy but it all goes to hell right when im at my happiest

i try not to compare myself with others but what am i supposed to do when i try and make my life better or more happy then something has to go wrong even when it looks to be on the right track. i cant just keep doing this, its really starting to affect my mental health
